lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For twenty years, King Jabin’s power and Sisera’s iron chariots pressed hard upon Israel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Under a palm between Ramah and Bethel sat Deborah—a prophet, a judge, and a listener.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: People brought their disputes to her, and she made room for truth, fairness, and peace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Israelites went up to her to have their disputes decided.

gameChoices: Decide before hearing the whole dispute
Listen to both sides and seek truth
gameSuccess: Wise judgment makes room for truth and peace.
gameRetry: Not quite. Wisdom begins by hearing both sides before deciding.
